WITH
eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
),

has_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT security_identifier, 'Y' as has_transactions_y_n
    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
),

has_dw_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT business_date, security_identifier, 'Y' as has_dw_transactions_y_n
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_capital_ledger_projections 
    WHERE 
        CAST(business_date as DATE) = CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
        AND CAST(expected_trade_date AS DATE) > CAST('2025-06-25' AS DATE)
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-25'                           AS business_date
   , '57f53a4c-1887-46a5-be54-5959cfcbb109'                                  AS run_id
   , '2025-06-26 12:30:03'                       AS extract_timestamp
   , '2025-06-26T12:30:03.835238-04:00'              AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601
   , 'America/Toronto'             AS extract_timestamp_time_zone
   , NULL                                        AS account_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS scd_id
   , SEC.security_identifier                     AS security_identifier
   , SEC.issuer_identifier                       AS issuer_identifier
   , SEC.cppib_security_id                       AS cppib_security_id
   , ISSUER.cppib_entity_id                      AS sentry_issuer_id
   , NULL                                        AS source_data_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS sentry_security_id
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_code
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS deal_id
   , SEC.dc_opportunity_id                       AS upstream_pipeline_number
   , SEC.security_name                           AS security_name
   , SEC.id_signal                               AS strategy
   , SEC.inv_group                               AS sub_strategy
   , SEC.security_name                           AS project_name
   , SEC.security_name                           AS investment_name
   , ISSUER.country_of_exposure                  AS country_of_exposure
   , SEC.currency                                AS funding_currency
   , NULL                                        AS deal_currency
   , SEC.private_vs_public                       AS private_vs_public
   , SEC.asset_category                          AS asset_category
   , SEC.seniority                               AS seniority
   , SEC.ir_rating                               AS risk_rating
   , SEC.asset_type                              AS asset_type
   , 'Credit Investments'                        AS investment_department_id
   , 'Active'                                    AS investment_status
   , 'Capital Call & Distribution Notices'       AS investment_lifecycle
   , NULL                                        AS deployment_disposition
   , ISSUER.gics_sector                          AS sector
   , NULL                                        AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local
   , NULL                                        AS funded_amount
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_net
   , COUP.maturity_date                          AS maturity_date
   , NULL                                        AS market_value
   , NULL                                        AS portfolio_name
   , SEC.sentry_security_type                    AS sentry_security_type
   , NULL                                        AS price_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS debt_factor
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_id
   , NULL                                        AS ticket_number
   , 80                                          AS probability_of_close
   , 'Binding'                                   AS binding
   , 'Net Purchases and Sales'                   AS capital_usage_component
   , NULL                                        AS transaction_cash_flow_type
   , 'Y'                                         AS send_to_treasury_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS expected_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_trade_date
   , CAST(NULLIF(SEC.expected_exit_price, '')    AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS expected_exit_price
   , SEC.expected_exit_probability               AS expected_exit_probability
   , SEC.expected_exit_date                      AS expected_exit_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm
   , NULL                                        AS unadjusted_exit_projection
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_by
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_date
   , 'ID_CI_WRITE'                               AS created_by_user_group
   , NULL                                        AS created_by
   , NULL                                        AS date_updated
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount
   , NULL                                        AS fo_comments
   , NULL                                        AS pec_recusals
   , NULL                                        AS pec_pipeline_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS fx_spot
   , NULL                                        AS full_amt_cad_mm
   , NULL                                        AS rejected_deals_reason
   , NULL                                        AS investment_program
   , NULL                                        AS investment_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS investment_group
   , NULL                                        AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS comment
   , NULL                                        AS error
   , 'reference_uat.ci_sentry_security, reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer, trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , '2025-06-25'        AS sentry_security_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-25' AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-25'          AS sentry_issuer_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-25'  AS sentry_cashflows_all_transactions_business_date
   , '2025-06-25' AS sentry_dw_transactions_business_date
   , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(SEC.dc_opportunity_id,'') as BIGINT)    AS dc_opportunity_id     --BIGINT
   , coalesce(HAS_TRANS.has_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_transactions_y_n
   , coalesce(HAS_DW_TRANS.has_dw_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_dw_transactions_y_n

FROM eligible_securities        AS SEC
LEFT JOIN issuer_list           AS ISSUER            ON SEC.issuer_identifier     = ISSUER.issuer_identifier
LEFT JOIN inv_group_mapping     AS INV_GROUP_MAP     ON SEC.inv_group             = INV_GROUP_MAP.inv_group
LEFT JOIN inv_strategy_mapping  AS INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP ON SEC.inv_strategy          = INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP.inv_strategy
LEFT JOIN has_transaction_list  AS HAS_TRANS         ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN has_dw_transaction_list  AS HAS_DW_TRANS   ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_DW_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN coupon_list           AS COUP              ON SEC.security_identifier   = COUP.security_identifier

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-26'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-26'

                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-26'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-26'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%9'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

                             ELSE 0

                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS pb_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END

                 SUM(

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0

                 OR EXISTS
                 (

                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                 )

                 child.cppib_party_id,
                 child.party_name,
                 child.rtg_final
         ),
     child_level_exp_limits AS
         (
             SELECT

                             ELSE 0

                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS der_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_fi_limit) AS der_smd_threshold,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,                 
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-17' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
									   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
                                       and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                                 )
                     )               
               AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 child.cppib_party_id
         ),
     breaches_under_parents AS
         (
             SELECT
                 cppib_party_id,
                 MIN(status) AS status
             FROM
                 (
                     SELECT
                         cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
                         CASE
                             WHEN total_cash_pb_exp >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit OR total_der_repo_sbl_exp >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit OR isrc_total_exp >= isrc_total_limit OR smd_total_exp >= smd_total_limit THEN 'BREACH'
                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits
                 ) p
             GROUP BY cppib_party_id
         )
SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

                             ELSE 0

                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,

                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-17' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
									   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
                                       and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'

               AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
             GROUP BY

         ),
     breaches_under_parents AS
         (
             SELECT
                 cppib_party_id,

             FROM
                 (
                     SELECT
                         cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
                         CASE

                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'

                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits

SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-17' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (

     breaches_under_parents AS

             FROM

SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id

     breaches_under_parents AS

SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,

    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,

    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

                             END AS status

         )
SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,

    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,

        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,

    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,

    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-04-25') and date '2025-04-25'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-04-25' and date '2025-04-25'
)
select business_date, business_date_adj, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name
from max_arrival_time
where arrival_time = max_publish

SELECT "business_date", "vendor", "base_currency", "to_currency", "is_exchange_holiday_flag", "exchange_rate"
FROM (with original_data as (
	select
		  data_date as business_date
		, vendor
		, 'CAD' as base_currency
		, currency as to_currency
		, is_exchange_holiday_flag
		, exchange_rate
	from
		market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
	where
		currency != 'CAD'
), inverse_data as (
	select
		  data_date as business_date
		, vendor
		, currency as base_currency
		, 'CAD' as to_currency
		, is_exchange_holiday_flag
		, 1 / exchange_rate as exchange_rate
	from
		market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
	where
		currency != 'CAD'
), combined_data_clean as (
	select *
	from (
		select * from original_data
		union all
		select * from inverse_data
	)
	where exchange_rate is not null 
)
select * from combined_data_clean) AS "finsights_markets_fx_cad"

with date_adjusted as (
    select business_date, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name, arrival_time,
        case
            when True and rm_name = 'cashRate' then date_add('day', 1, business_date)
            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-04-29') and date '2025-04-29'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-04-29' and date '2025-04-29'
)
select business_date, business_date_adj, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name
from max_arrival_time
where arrival_time = max_publish
